name: Porto's Bakery (Buena Park, CA) Crispy Golden Chicken Croquettes (Croquetas de Pollo)
whyItWorks: Finely minced seasoned chicken breast bound in smooth béchamel sauce, breaded and fried golden. Creamy interior dissolves smoothly with no tough gristle.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order 2-3 warm Chicken Croquettes for a light savory bite.
watchOuts: Fried crust carries light oil; eat slowly
